title: Pip and the Sneezy Sunflower Seed
moral: When at first you don't succeed, try, try again!
description: Nana Hoot gives Pip a tiny stripy sunflower seed, but growing it is harder than it looks, especially with a sneezy elephant nearby! Learn what a seed needs to grow with Pip, Hazel, Tumble and Nana Hoot in this funny animated story about trying again, for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Sneezy Sunflower Seed!

narration.text: Good morning, friends! Today, Nana Hoot had a teeny-tiny surprise for Pip and Hazel.
Hoo-hoo! This is a sunflower SEED. Plant it, and it will grow taller than Tumble!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: A seed! Can you say SEED with me? Seeeed!
Super-duper! I will grow a sunny-flowery-tower-thingy!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Just then, Nana's glasses slid down her beak. Slide, slide... BOINK! Right on her toes!

narration.text: Pip zoomed to the garden. ZIP! He put the seed on a big, flat rock.
Now GROW, little seed! Grow, grow, GROOOOW!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Pip waited. And waited. The seed did not grow one teeny bit!
Tee-hee-hee! Pip, seeds don't grow on rocks!
narration.speaker: hazel

narration.text: Where does a seed like to sleep, friends? Under the...
SOIL! Soft, brown soil! You're so smart!

narration.text: Try number two! Pip dug a hole in the soil. Dig, dig, dig! Plop went the seed.
Then along came Tumble. Stomp, stomp, stomp!
Ooh, a seed! HONK! Let me sniff it... ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
narration.speaker: tumble

narration.text: WHOOOSH! The soil flew everywhere, and the seed went BOING, right onto Pip's nose!
Oopsie-trunk! Sorry, Pip!
narration.speaker: tumble

narration.text: Oh nooo. This is too hard. I give up!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Don't give up, Pip! Let's try again, together!
narration.speaker: hazel

narration.text: Try number three! Dig, plop, pat, pat, pat. The seed was snug in the soil.
Now the seed was thirsty. Tumble filled his trunk at the pond and... SPLOOSH!
He watered the seed... AND Pip! Drip, drip, drip! And look, a little rainbow!
Brrr! Super-duper soggy! But my seed needs WATER!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: What else does a seed need to grow? Look up in the sky, friends!
SUNSHINE! The warm, yellow sun! Hooray!
Soil, water, sunshine... so where is my flower? Come out, seed!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Pip pulled and pulled at the soil. Stretchhhh... wibble-wobble... flop!
Tee-hee-hee! Pip, a seed needs TIME!
narration.speaker: hazel

narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Let's peek under the soil with my magic looking-bubble!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: Look! Under the soil, the seed is waking up! Tiny ROOTS wiggle down, down, down.
Roots drink up the water. Then a little shoot pushes up, up to the sun... zzzz...
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: Silly Nana! Growing takes time. So every day, Pip watered... and waited... and waited.

narration.text: Then one morning... POP! A tiny green SPROUT poked out of the soil!
It grew! It grew! Super-duper-DUPER!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: How many little leaves can YOU count?
One, two, three, four! Four green leaves! Great counting!
HONK! Hello, little sprout!

narration.text: The sunflower grew, and grew, and GREW! Taller than Pip, taller than Hazel, even taller than Tumble!
And on top was a big, bright, yellow FLOWER!
It's so pretty! Let me sniff it... ah... ah... AHHH...
narration.speaker: tumble

narration.text: Uh-oh! Everybody, hold on tight!
...choo.
narration.speaker: tumble

narration.text: A teeny-tiny sneeze! Everybody giggled and giggled!

narration.text: Let's remember! What three things does a seed need to grow?
Soil, water and sunshine! Yes!
And what grows down, down, down under the soil?
ROOTS! You remembered!
Hoo-hoo-HOO! And Pip tried again, and again, and never gave up!

narration.text: The big sunflower was full of new seeds. So Pip shared them with all his friends!
If at first it doesn't grow... try, try again!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: And together, they planted a whole row of sunny seeds. Pat, pat, pat!
HONK! Next year, a sunflower forest!
narration.speaker: tumble
